title: Applied Digital to develop 1GW data center campus in Finland
source_used: W.Media (relaying the Applied Digital press release) and Stocktwits relay on Yahoo Finance
key_facts: Applied Digital, a US builder of AI data centers, entered an agreement for access to up to 1 GW of potential power capacity in Finland on 6 Oct 2026.
It is the company's first development opportunity outside the United States.
It plans an AI Factory campus there, with initial power expected from 2028.
The company has begun marketing the site and is talking to global hyperscale (very large cloud) customers; no customer is named.
Investment depends on customer demand, commercial milestones and regulatory and development approvals.
The company has not said how much power would be available at the first stage, where the site is, or when full capacity could arrive.
CEO Wes Cummins called it a 'deliberate first step', not a change in strategy.
quote_evidence: Applied Digital has not disclosed how much power would be available at that development stage or where the site is located and when it could reach its full potential capacity.
Applied Digital has started marketing the site and is already in discussions with leading global hyperscale customers.
why_it_matters_hint: A US AI data center developer is moving to the Nordics, but only as an option on power, with no customer signed.
notes: DCD returned 403. Headline says 'to develop'; the facts show an agreement for access to potential power, with spending conditional, so the entry says that.
